description: Use this tool to CALCULATE a 3D printing price. Provide material_name, color, lead_time (must match the 3dp-pricing dictionary), quantity, and either weight_g or volume_cm3 — or an uploaded file_key (obtained from /v1/uploads/presign + /v1/uploads/complete) which is parsed to get volume. This tool does NOT create an order; it returns part_price / total / order_url. Output is desensitized (no unit prices).

parts.description: One or more part lines. Each line is priced independently.

color.description: Color — must match a 3dp-pricing entry. E.g. 'White', 'Black', 'Natural'.

file_key.description: R2 object key of a CAD file uploaded by this principal (uploads/{principal_id}/...). Parsed via parse_cad to obtain volume.

lead_time.description: Lead time tier — must match a 3dp-pricing entry. E.g. 'Standard', 'Express', 'Economy'.

material_name.description: Material name — must match a 3dp-pricing entry (case-insensitive). E.g. 'PA12', 'Resin Standard', 'PEEK'.

notes.description: Optional notes for this part line (e.g. surface finish).

quantity.description: Number of pieces for this part line.

volume_cm3.description: Single-part volume in cm³. Weight = volume × density. Required if weight_g/file_key not provided.

weight_g.description: Single-part weight in grams (preferred). If provided, volume_cm3/file_key are ignored.

name: quote_calc
